target_polygon: Purdue BuildingShapesZip4 FID 199, WGS84 ring transformed to EPSG:2968
roof_surface_filter: ASPRS class 1 returns inside footprint eroded 3 m
ground_filter: ASPRS class 2 returns within 5 m external footprint buffer
method: Median class-1 surface elevation minus median class-2 ground in exterior buffer; 3m erosion applied in feetUS in EPSG:2968. Nearest-rank quantiles.
interpretation: Roof height is an estimate from unclassified surface points; no class-6 building returns in tile. Interior central statistic can include remaining vegetation or non-roof returns; compare spread and orthophoto. GIS reports four levels but its Extrution/R fields have undocumented units.
